description: Render an approved draft. Call ONLY after the user has seen the draft and said yes. Charges the draft's estimatedCredits now (40 with the default voice), before any rendering work; refunded automatically if the render fails for good. Narration is read verbatim and each scene shows its visual; targetDuration is recorded as requested, and the video runs as long as its narration takes to read (any mismatch was in the draft's warnings). Retry-safe: a repeated call returns the first submission and charges nothing. A short balance returns 402 and keeps the draft. Rendering is asynchronous: poll autoshort_get_video every 20-30 seconds until status is COMPLETED or FAILED. If get_video returns blockedReason, stop polling and act on it (e.g. top up credits).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional; recorded with the submission. The draft itself can only be rendered once.

name: autoshort_render_draft
